newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila feed millers buy 55,000T yellow corn.
newsitem.headline: Manila feed millers buy 55,000T yellow corn.

text.p: The Philippine Association of Feed Millers Inc on Monday bought 55,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn no 2 at $137.75 per tonne C&F, traders who joined the bidding said.

Continental Grains Co won the tender to supply the corn for July 10-25 arrival, they said. The bidding was the second held by the feed millers. The group rejected tenders submitted on Friday on hopes of lower prices this week.
Continental had submitted the lowest bid of $137.50 per tonne in Friday's tender, which millers rejected because they wanted Continental to lower the price to around $133, said one trader.
"Today, the millers have no choice but to buy despite higher U.S. prices to meet short term requirements," the trader said. Philippine feed millers are importing the corn at 80 percent tariff.
